找.pinyin: Zhè zhèng shì wǒ zài zhǎo de tā hǎn dào
找.en: "This is what I was looking for!" he exclaimed.
找.es: —¡Esto es lo que estaba buscando! —exclamó él.

找.zh: 请帮我找一下我的钱包。
找.pinyin: Qǐng bāng wǒ zhǎo yī xià wǒ de qián bāo
找.es: Por favor, ayúdame a encontrar mi cartera.

找.zh: 我找到那把我一直在找的钥匙了。
找.pinyin: Wǒ zhǎo dào nà bǎ wǒ yī zhí zài zhǎo de yào shi le
找.en: I found the key for which I had been looking.
找.es: He encontrado la llave que estaba buscando.

找.zh: 这就是你正在找的那本书。
找.pinyin: Zhè jiù shì nǐ zhèng zài zhǎo de nà běn shū
找.en: This is the book which you are looking for.
找.es: Éste es el libro que buscas.

课.pinyin: Wǒ men zhōu sān xià wǔ méi kè
课.en: We don't have class on Wednesday afternoons.
课.es: No tenemos clase los miércoles por la tarde.

课.zh: 今天下午我有两个小时的英语课和两个小时的汉语课。
课.pinyin: Jīn tiān xià wǔ wǒ yǒu liǎng gè xiǎo shí de yīng yǔ kè hé liǎng gè xiǎo shí de hàn yǔ kè
课.en: This afternoon I have English class for two hours and then two hours of Chinese.
课.es: Esta tarde tengo dos horas de clase de inglés y dos horas de clase de chino.

课.pinyin: Nǐ cóng lái méi kè hái shi zěn yàng
课.en: You never have class or what?!

课.zh: 我妹妹每周上两次钢琴课。
课.pinyin: Wǒ mèi mei měi zhōu shàng liǎng cì gāng qín kè
课.en: My sister takes piano lessons twice a week.
课.es: Mi hermana pequeña tiene clases de piano dos veces a la semana.

百.pinyin: Wǒ yī tiān zhuàn yī bǎi ōu yuán
Wǒ yī tiān zhèng yī bǎi ōu yuán

百.zh: 出席的学生不下五百人。
百.pinyin: Chū xí de xué sheng bù xià wǔ bǎi rén
百.en: No fewer than five hundred students were present.
百.es: No menos de quinientos estudiantes estaban presentes.

百.pinyin: Gōng sī yǒu wǔ bǎi gè zhí yuán

难.pinyin: Tā hěn nán xiě tā de míng zi
难.en: He can scarcely write his name.
难.es: Él apenas puede escribir su nombre.

难.zh: 和一个只说"是"与"否"的人维持一段对话是很难的。
难.pinyin: Hé yī ge zhǐ shuō shì yǔ fǒu de rén wéi chí yī duàn duì huà shì hěn nán de
难.en: It is difficult to keep up a conversation with someone who only says "yes" and "no".
难.es: Es difícil mantener una conversación con alguien que sólo dice "sí" y "no".

难.zh: 跟一个只说“是”和“不是”的人很难继续谈话。
难.pinyin: Gēn yī ge zhǐ shuō shì hé bù shì de rén hěn nán jì xù tán huà
难.en: It is difficult to keep up a conversation with someone who only says "yes" and "no".
难.es: Es difícil mantener una conversación con alguien que sólo dice "sí" y "no".

难.pinyin: Wǒ fā xiàn dú zhè běn shū hěn nán
难.en: I find this book is very difficult to read.
难.es: Este libro me pareció difícil de leer.

放.zh: 我总是在离手不远的地方放一本字典。
放.pinyin: Wǒ zǒng shì zài lí shǒu bù yuǎn de dì fang fàng yī běn zì diǎn
放.en: I always keep a dictionary close at hand.
放.es: Siempre tengo un diccionario a la mano.

放.pinyin: Bǎ nǐ de zì xíng chē fàng hǎo
Tā bǎ shū fàng zài le zhuō shàng
放.en: He put the book on the table.
放.es: Dejó el libro en la mesa.

放.pinyin: Zhè tāng lǐ yán fàng duō le
放.en: There's too much salt in this soup.

习惯.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de rén xí guàn le hán lěng
习惯.en: The people here are used to the cold.
习惯.es: La gente aquí está acostumbrada al frío.

习惯.zh: 一个国家的风俗习惯反映了它的文化。
习惯.pinyin: Yī ge guó jiā de fēng sú xí guàn fǎn yìng le tā de wén huà
习惯.en: The manners and customs of a country reflect its culture.
习惯.es: Los usos y costumbres de un país reflejan su cultura.

习惯.zh: 你很快就会习惯新工作了。
习惯.pinyin: Nǐ hěn kuài jiù huì xí guàn xīn gōng zuò le
习惯.en: You'll soon get accustomed to the work.

习惯.zh: 一旦养成了坏习惯，就很难改回来了。
习惯.pinyin: Yī dàn yǎng chéng le huài xí guàn jiù hěn nán gǎi huí lai le
习惯.en: A bad habit, once formed, is difficult to get rid of.
习惯.es: Es difícil deshacerse de un mal hábito, cuando éste ya ha arraigado.

欢迎.pinyin: Tā hěn shòu péng you huān yíng
Huān yíng lái dào sān fān shì

周末.zh: 我爸爸会在这周末回家。
周末.pinyin: Wǒ bà ba huì zài zhè zhōu mò huí jiā
周末.en: My father will come home at the end of this week.
周末.es: Mi padre vendrá a casa este fin de semana.

周末.zh: 这个周末你可以抽点时间教我法文吗？
周末.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōu mò nǐ kě yǐ chōu diǎn shí jiān jiāo wǒ fǎ wén ma
周末.en: Will you have a little time this weekend to help me with my French?
周末.es: ¿Tendrás un rato corto este fin de semana para ayudarme con mi francés?

周末.zh: 过去我们每个周末都去溜冰。
周末.pinyin: Guò qù wǒ men měi ge zhōu mò dōu qù liū bīng
周末.en: We used to go skating every weekend.
周末.es: Antes íbamos a patinar sobre hielo todos los fines de semana.

周末.pinyin: Rú guǒ kě néng de huà zhè zhōu mò
周末.es: Este fin de semana, si es posible.

直接.zh: 我直接从他那里得到讯息。
直接.pinyin: Wǒ zhí jiē cóng tā nà li dé dào xùn xī
直接.en: I got the information from him directly.
直接.es: Obtuve la información directamente de él.

直接.pinyin: Gōng zuò zhī hòu wǒ zhí jiē huí jiā
直接.en: After work I go straight home.
直接.es: Voy directo a casa después del trabajo.

直接.zh: 今天糟糕透了，所以我准备去喝一杯就直接上床。
直接.pinyin: Jīn tiān zāo gāo tòu le suǒ yǐ wǒ zhǔn bèi qù hē yī bēi jiù zhí jiē shàng chuáng
直接.en: I had an awful experience today, so I'm going to have a beer and go straight to bed.
直接.es: He tenido una experiencia terrible hoy, así que voy a tomarme una cerveza y a irme a la cama.

直接.zh: 这条路是不是直接通往普拉多博物馆？
直接.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù shì bu shì zhí jiē tōng wǎng pǔ lā duō bó wù guǎn
直接.en: Is this the direct way to the Prado?
直接.es: ¿Es éste el camino directo al Prado?

判断.zh: 不要以穿着来判断一个人。
判断.pinyin: Bù yào yǐ chuān zhuó lái pàn duàn yī gè rén
判断.en: Don't judge a man by his clothes.
判断.es: No juzgues a un hombre por su ropa.

判断.zh: 不能根据服装来判断一个人。
判断.pinyin: Bù néng gēn jù fú zhuāng lái pàn duàn yī gè rén
判断.en: You can't judge a person based on clothing.
判断.es: No se puede juzgar a una persona por su ropa.

判断.zh: 不要根据封面来判断一本书。
判断.pinyin: Bù yào gēn jù fēng miàn lái pàn duàn yī běn shū
判断.en: Don't judge a book by its cover.

判断.zh: 必须判断一个行为是否符合道德标准。
判断.pinyin: Bì xū pàn duàn yī ge xíng wéi shì fǒu fú hé dào dé biāo zhǔn
判断.en: It needs to be judged on whether it meets the ethical standards.
判断.es: Hay que juzgar la moralidad de una acción.

亚洲.zh: 我对亚洲的历史很感兴趣。
亚洲.pinyin: Wǒ duì yà zhōu de lì shǐ hěn gǎn xìng qù
亚洲.en: I am interested in Asian history.
亚洲.es: Me interesa la historia de Asia.

亚洲.zh: 最近，来自亚洲各国的进口额不断扩大。
亚洲.pinyin: Zuì jìn lái zì yà zhōu gè guó de jìn kǒu é bù duàn kuò dà
亚洲.en: The imports from Asian countries have expanded recently.
亚洲.es: Las importaciones desde Asia se han expandido recientemente.

亚洲.zh: 他访问过许多亚洲国家。
亚洲.pinyin: Tā fǎng wèn guo xǔ duō yà zhōu guó jiā
亚洲.en: He visited many countries in Asia.
亚洲.es: Él visitó muchos países en Asia.

举.zh: 你举了一个不好的例子。
举.pinyin: Nǐ jǔ le yī ge bù hǎo de lì zi

举.zh: 你可以给我举个例子吗？
举.pinyin: Nǐ kě yǐ gěi wǒ jǔ gè lì zi ma
举.en: Can you give me an example?

举.zh: 让我来给你举个例子吧。
举.pinyin: Ràng wǒ lái gěi nǐ jǔ gè lì zi ba
举.en: Let me give you an example.

举.pinyin: Zài gěi wǒ jǔ gè lì zi

郊区.pinyin: Wǒ zhù zài dōng jīng jiāo qū
郊区.en: I live on the outskirts of Tokyo.
郊区.es: Vivo en las afueras de Tokio.

郊区.zh: 海伦和凯蒂在东京郊区租了个套间。
郊区.pinyin: Hǎi lún hé kǎi dì zài dōng jīng jiāo qū zū le gè tào jiān
郊区.en: Helen and Kathy rented an apartment in a suburb of Tokyo.
郊区.es: Helen y Kathy alquilaron un departamento en los suburbios de Tokio.

郊区.pinyin: Wǒ men zhù zài jiāo qū

郊区.zh: 要住在郊区的话，汽车是必需的。
郊区.pinyin: Yào zhù zài jiāo qū de huà qì chē shì bì xū de
郊区.en: You need a car if you live in the suburbs.

博物馆.pinyin: Bó wù guǎn de rù kǒu zài nǎ
博物馆.en: Where is the entrance to the museum?

博物馆.zh: 博物馆的参观者中有少数是外国人。
博物馆.pinyin: Bó wù guǎn de cān guān zhě zhōng yǒu shǎo shù shì wài guó rén
博物馆.en: There was a sprinkling of foreigners among the visitors in the museum.
博物馆.es: Había un número pequeño de extranjeros entre los visitantes del museo.

博物馆.pinyin: Zhè chéng lǐ yǒu méi yǒu bó wù guǎn
博物馆.en: Is there a museum in this town?

博物馆.zh: 那位作家用过的傢俱全都存放在这间博物馆里。
博物馆.pinyin: Nà wèi zuò jiā yòng guo de jiā jù quán dōu cún fàng zài zhè jiān bó wù guǎn lǐ
博物馆.en: The writer's furniture is all shown in this museum.
博物馆.es: Todos los muebles del escritor son mostrados en el museo.

地震.zh: 那是有史以来最强烈的一次地震。
地震.pinyin: Nà shi yǒu shǐ yǐ lái zuì qiáng liè de yī cì dì zhèn
地震.en: It was the greatest earthquake on record.

地震.zh: 地震过后，许多人都失去了家园。
地震.pinyin: Dì zhèn guò hòu xǔ duō rén dōu shī qù le jiā yuán
地震.en: Many lost their homes after the earthquake.
地震.es: Muchos perdieron sus hogares después del terremoto.

地震.pinyin: Dì zhèn suí shí dōu kě néng fā shēng
地震.en: An earthquake can take place at any time.
地震.es: Puede haber un terremoto en cualquier momento.

太太.zh: 他的去世让他的太太大受打击。
太太.pinyin: Tā de qù shì ràng tā de tài tai dà shòu dǎ jī
太太.en: His death was great shock to his wife.
太太.es: Su muerte le causó un gran impacto a su mujer.

太太.pinyin: Nǐ tài tai zěn me yàng

太太.zh: 夏里斯太太对她儿子的前途没有甚么信心。
太太.pinyin: Xià lǐ sī tài tai duì tā ér zi de qián tú méi yǒu shèn má xìn xīn
太太.en: Mrs. Harris is very doubtful about her son's future.
太太.es: La señora Harris tiene muchas dudas sobre el futuro de su hijo.

太太.zh: 他太太来自于加利福尼亚州。
太太.pinyin: Tā tài tai lái zì yú jiā lì fú ní yà zhōu

实现.pinyin: Tā de mèng xiǎng zuì zhōng shí xiàn le
实现.en: His dream has come true at last.
实现.es: Su sueño se ha realizado por fin.

实现.zh: 你努力工作的话，就可以实现你的梦想。
实现.pinyin: Nǐ nǔ lì gōng zuò de huà jiù kě yǐ shí xiàn nǐ de mèng xiǎng
实现.en: You can make your dream come true by working hard.
实现.es: Trabajando duro, puedes hacer que tu sueño se haga realidad.

实现.zh: 希望我的愿望能够实现。
实现.pinyin: Xī wàng wǒ de yuàn wàng néng gòu shí xiàn
实现.en: I hope I can get my wish fulfilled.

赞成.pinyin: Wǒ zàn chéng nǐ de shuō fǎ
Wǒ zàn chéng nǐ de jì huà

赞成.zh: 你赞成他在书中说的话吗？
赞成.pinyin: Nǐ zàn chéng tā zài shū zhōng shuō de huà ma
赞成.en: Do you agree with what he says in the book?
赞成.es: ¿Tú estás de acuerdo con lo que él dice en el libro?

赞成.zh: 父亲绝不会赞成我结婚。
赞成.pinyin: Fù qīn jué bù huì zàn chéng wǒ jié hūn
赞成.en: Father will never approve of my marriage.
赞成.es: Mi padre nunca va a aprobar mi casamiento.

派.zh: 你能派人拿一些衣服，好吗？
派.pinyin: Nǐ néng pài rén ná yī xiē yī fu hǎo ma
派.en: Could you send someone up to pick up some laundry?
派.es: ¿Podrías mandar a alguien a recoger ropa limpia?

派.zh: 你认为我们应该派人去请医生来吗?
派.pinyin: Nǐ rèn wéi wǒ men yīng gāi pài rén qù qǐng yī shēng lái ma
派.en: Do you think we should send for the doctor?

派.zh: 他发现他上学学的东西，在商界根本派不上用场。
派.pinyin: Tā fā xiàn tā shàng xué xué de dōng xi zài shāng jiè gēn běn pài bù shàng yòng chǎng
派.en: He found that the things he had studied in school were not useful in the business world.

派.zh: 你会派人去请医生来吗?
派.pinyin: Nǐ huì pài rén qù qǐng yī shēng lái ma
派.en: Will you send for a doctor?

自豪.zh: 我为我的兄弟感到自豪。
自豪.pinyin: Wǒ wèi wǒ de xiōng dì gǎn dào zì háo

自豪.zh: 给我机会来让你为我感到自豪。
自豪.pinyin: Gěi wǒ jī huì lái ràng nǐ wèi wǒ gǎn dào zì háo
自豪.en: Give me a chance to make you proud of me.
自豪.es: Dame la oportunidad de hacerte orgulloso de mí.

自豪.zh: 她不自豪她所有的优点。
自豪.pinyin: Tā bù zì háo tā suǒ yǒu de yōu diǎn
自豪.en: With all her merits she was not proud.
自豪.es: Ella no estaba orgullosa a pesar de todos sus méritos.

自豪.zh: 他父亲是个伟大的科学家，他很自豪。
自豪.pinyin: Tā fù qīn shì gè wěi dà de kē xué jiā tā hěn zì háo
自豪.en: He is proud that his father was a great scientist.
自豪.es: Le da orgullo que su padre fuera un gran científico.

雾.pinyin: Wǒ men zài wù zhōng mí le lù
雾.en: We got lost in the fog.

雾.zh: 除了雾我什么都看不见。
雾.pinyin: Chú le wù wǒ shén me dōu kàn bu jiàn
雾.en: I could see nothing but fog.

雾.zh: 我住的地方－伦敦，从前以雾闻名。
雾.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de dì fang lún dūn cóng qián yǐ wù wén míng
雾.en: London, where I live, used to be famous for its fog.
雾.es: Londres, donde vivo, solía ser famosa por su niebla.

雾.pinyin: Tài yang yī chū lái wù jiù sǎn le
雾.en: As the sun rose, the fog disappeared.

领导.pinyin: Dài wǒ qù jiàn nǐ men de lǐng dǎo
Tā men xū yào lǐng dǎo tuán duì
Xiè xie nǐ de lǐng dǎo

领导.zh: 对我们来说，最重要的是领会领导意图。
领导.pinyin: Duì wǒ men lái shuō zuì zhòng yào de shì lǐng huì lǐng dǎo yì tú
领导.en: For us, what’s most important is understanding the intention of the leadership.

签.zh: 你在这里签个名就行了。
签.pinyin: Nǐ zài zhè lǐ qiān gè míng jiù xíng le
签.en: All you have to do is sign your name here.

签.zh: 不要忘记签上你的名字。
签.pinyin: Bù yào wàng jì qiān shàng nǐ de míng zi
签.en: Don't forget to sign your name.
签.es: No te olvides firmar tu nombre.

签.zh: 我和这家公司签了三年合同。
签.pinyin: Wǒ hé zhè jiā gōng sī qiān le sān nián hé tong
签.en: This company and I have signed a contract of three years.
签.es: Esta compañía y yo firmamos un contrato a tres años.

哲学.zh: 哲学不是我们用六个月就能学的东西。
哲学.pinyin: Zhé xué bù shì wǒ men yòng liù gè yuè jiù néng xué de dōng xi
哲学.en: Philosophy is not a thing one can learn in six months.
哲学.es: La filosofía no es algo que uno puede aprender en seis meses.

哲学.zh: 汤姆在大学里学的是哲学。
哲学.pinyin: Tāng mǔ zài dà xué lǐ xué de shì zhé xué

哲学.zh: 第一个吸引我注意的科目是哲学。
哲学.pinyin: Dì yī gè xī yǐn wǒ zhù yì de kē mù shì zhé xué
哲学.en: The first subject that attracted my attention was philosophy.

寂寞.pinyin: Tāng mǔ gǎn dào shí fēn jì mò
Wǒ de jì mò shì yī tiáo shé
Wǒ zuì jìn hěn jì mò
寂寞.en: I feel very lonely these days.

农村.zh: 大多数中国人是非常好客的，尤其是住在农村的人。
农村.pinyin: Dà duō shù zhōng guó rén shì fēi cháng hào kè de yóu qí shì zhù zài nóng cūn de rén
农村.en: Many Chinese people make good guests, especially those from rural areas.

农村.zh: 我也是从农村出来的，对贫困有着切身感受。
农村.pinyin: Wǒ yě shì cóng nóng cūn chū lái de duì pín kùn yǒu zhe qiè shēn gǎn shòu
农村.en: I also come from the countryside, so I have a first-hand understanding of poverty.

农村.pinyin: Tā bì yè hòu huí dào le nóng cūn
农村.en: He went back to the village after he graduated.

农村.zh: 在这二百年来，有很多人从农村搬到了市区居住。
农村.pinyin: Zài zhè èr bǎi nián lái yǒu hěn duō rén cóng nóng cūn bān dào le shì qū jū zhù
农村.en: This movement from rural to urban areas has been going on for over two hundred years.

农民.pinyin: Nóng mín zǒng shì bào yuàn tiān qì
农民.en: Farmers always complain about the weather.
农民.es: Los granjeros se la pasan quejando del clima.

农民.pinyin: Nóng mín zài chūn tiān bō zhǒng
农民.en: Farmers sow seeds in the spring.
农民.es: Los granjeros siembran semillas en la primavera.

农民.pinyin: Nóng mín shì guó jiā de xīn zàng

双方.zh: 首先，我要听听双方的意见。

核心.en: The heart of Esperanto ideology is the equality of all languages and cultures.

干脆.zh: 他跟他们干脆地断绝来往了。

干脆.en: He made a clean break with them.

场面.en: I went to Wei-hong's wedding. It was huge.

恰巧.zh: 恰巧我们有同样的生日。

水泥.zh: 水泥会在数个小时内凝固。
